title: Popup scroll clipping fix

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.notes: Checked overflow clipping, portal, floating overflow, and modal scroll guidance.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.notes: Added popup layer tokens, Radix available-height max-height, internal popup scroll, and collision padding.

phases.label: Validation
phases.notes: workspace-monitor tests/check/source smoke, Browser smoke, platform-desktop-app test/check, package:internal, codesign verify, and hdiutil verify completed.

bottleneck_notes: Browser source file picker required scrolling the trigger into view before measuring the popup; this matched the reported scroll-related visibility issue.
